intro: Apothecary Lydon is a morbid researcher of the Royal Apothecary Society stationed in Tarren Mill. Chronically depressed and intensely bored, he finds joy only in refining lethal concoctions and watching the living suffer. He spearheads the research into potent new toxins aimed at securing Hillsbrad for the Forsaken and furthering Sylvanas's New Plague.

p: Stationed inside the chapel turned laboratory of Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon represents the cold, calculating ethos of the Royal Apothecary Society. He is afflicted by a profound, languid melancholy, disgusted by the blooming flowers and crisp air of Hillsbrad Foothills. The only diversion that lifts his perpetual gloom is the art of deathcraft. When left unattended, he passes the time poisoning, dissecting, and reanimating his unfortunate pet frog, Umpi, repeatedly waiting for new reagents to arrive.
